$about: Placeholder registry for the commerce copy manifest. Every {name} that appears in commerce-source-en.json, with its meaning. Translators must keep placeholder names EXACTLY as-is.

countryName.meaning: Localized country name of the shipping address (Intl.DisplayNames via localizeCountryName, threaded with the market locale); falls back to checkout.shipping.yourAddressFallback when unresolvable. Grammar note: interpolated after Slovak preposition "Pre" (accusative).

email.meaning: customer email the confirmation is sent to (order.userEmail; may be an empty string, sentence then ends after 'adresu')

field.meaning: The localized address-field label, e.g. 'Mesto' / 'PSČ' (already translated via the address field label keys)

gateway.meaning: Payment gateway display name, e.g. Stripe

gateways.meaning: Comma-separated list of gateway entries in the form Name (id)

max.meaning: method.maximumDeliveryDays (number); also drives the plural branch

name.meaning: attribute name from Saleor backend data (e.g. "Size")

newTotal.meaning: Formatted new order total including currency symbol (getFormattedMoney)

number.meaning: order number as displayed to the customer

orderNumber.meaning: Saleor order number (e.g. 1023); in the dormant demo confirmation step a DEMO-XXXXXX code

previousTotal.meaning: Formatted previous order total including currency symbol (getFormattedMoney)

product.meaning: product name of the cart line from Saleor

total.meaning: Formatted order total with currency, e.g. 0,00 €

value.meaning: attribute value name from Saleor backend data (e.g. "XL")

variant.meaning: variant name from Saleor backend data
